title: The Catacendre
summary: Harmony rebuilds Scadrial. The planet is moved back to its correct orbit, the ash and mist disappear. The surviving skaa and nobles must learn to live in a new world. Elendel is founded as the city of the future.
archivistNote: The Catacendre represents the only known instance of a single person assuming two Shards simultaneously and successfully merging them. Whether Harmony’s dual nature is a strength or a limitation remains a central question in Cosmere theology.
